name: get_fact_history
description: Return the append-only event lineage for (tenant_id, subject, predicate) in observed order: op, outcome, value, source, assessor_type, confidence, policy_version, temporal fields, and hash-chain links. Tenant-scoped; no free-form SQL. tenant_id is the requested data scope (authorization handled by the Gateway governance layer).

tenant_id.description: Tenant whose data this operation is scoped to (requested data scope). The Gateway governance layer authorizes whether the caller may select it.

subject.description: The subject/entity key the fact is about.

limit.description: Max events to return, intended range 1..500 (default 500). Upper bound still capped server-side; DEGRADATION: the Gateway no longer enforces the lower bound >=1.
